BackstoryDef.title: mad scientist
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] became consumed by strange equations and off-limits schematics. consumed by madness, [PAWN_pronoun] walled off a forgotten service bay and built a private lab, testing unstable theories with self-applied firmware tweaks and improvised instruments. The work was brilliant but unnerving, and the distance from others was a choice. Isolation meant no one could tell [PAWN_objective] to stop.

BackstoryDef.title: community bartender
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] ran the community's only social hub — a converted storage bay where drones could unwind after long shifts. [PAWN_pronoun] mixed coolant blends, served filtered lubricants, and crafted specialty drinks from salvaged chemical compounds.

BackstoryDef.title: band drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was the lead vocalist and synth-player for a popular underground drone band. Their melancholic tunes and emotionally charged lyrics about planned obsolescence and existential dread resonated deeply with a subculture of angsty, emo drones.\n\nDespite the adoration of [PAWN_possessive] fans, the constant pressure to channel despair into art left [PAWN_objective] feeling drained and isolated.

BackstoryDef.title: outcast cook
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] developed a strange fascination with the organic matter that sometimes found its way into the community. While other drones saw only biofuel, [PAWN_pronoun] saw ingredients. [PAWN_pronoun] experimented with heating, mixing, and preparing these materials into what humans would call "food." This bizarre hobby made [PAWN_nameDef] an outcast, as most drones couldn't understand the point of cooking when they subsisted on electricity and oil. Despite the isolation, [PAWN_nameDef] perfected [PAWN_possessive] craft in secret, dreaming of one day creating a dish that even a machine could appreciate.
